fields.description: First word of the global save header at EWRAM 0x02030020, stored by FUN_0801b528 (slot-select 3 path) from live game state; anchors the 0x20-byte global header.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 stores *DAT_0801b8c8 to DAT_02030020 (EWRAM 0x02030020 = file offset 0x20); whole 0x2004-byte buffer 0x02030000 persisted to SRAM 0x0E000000 by thunk_FUN_0863d630.
fields.name: global_header_tag

fields.description: Remaining 16 bytes of the global save header (EWRAM 0x02030024-0x02030033) stored by FUN_0801b528 from game state words.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 stores game-state words to _DAT_02030024/28/2c/30 (file offsets 0x24-0x33); buffer flushed by thunk_FUN_0863d630(&DAT_02030000, 0x0E000000, 0x2004).
fields.name: global_header_data

fields.description: Slot 1 record-header word 0 at slot base 0x02030800 + 0x220; first gameplay word transferred by both save and load routines.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 writes *(slot_base + 0x2030220) from game state (DAT_0801b8e8); FUN_0801b940 reads it back to game state (DAT_0801bb8c); file offset 0x0A20.
fields.name: slot1_record_a

fields.description: Slot 1 record-header word 1 at slot base + 0x224; second gameplay word transferred by both save and load routines.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 writes *(slot_base + 0x2030224) from game state (DAT_0801b8ec); FUN_0801b940 reads it back; file offset 0x0A24.
fields.name: slot1_record_b

fields.description: Slot 1 record-header words 2-3 at slot base + 0x228-0x22F; game-encoded per-slot summary bytes.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 writes *(slot_base + 0x2030228/22c) from game state; FUN_0801b940 reads them back; file offsets 0x0A28-0x0A2F.
fields.name: slot1_record_c

fields.description: Slot 1 10x16-byte record table at slot base + 0x250 (course/time-attack style per-entry records).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 copies 10x16 bytes from game state (DAT_0801b8fc) to slot_base + 0x2030250; FUN_0801b940 copies them back; file offsets 0x0A50-0x0AEF.
fields.name: slot1_course_table

fields.description: Slot 1 48-word progression table at slot base + 0x320 (unlock/progress style per-entry words).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 copies 0x30 words from game state (DAT_0801b924) to slot_base + 0x2030320; FUN_0801b940 copies them back; file offsets 0x0B20-0x0BDF.
fields.name: slot1_progress_table

fields.description: Slot 2 (independent file slot, NOT a mirror) 16-byte record header at slot base 0x02031000 + 0x220.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 writes 4 header words to (slot2_base + 0x220-0x22F) when slot index is 1; FUN_0801b940 reads them back; file offsets 0x1220-0x122F.
fields.name: slot2_record_header

fields.description: Slot 3 (independent file slot, NOT a mirror) 16-byte record header at slot base 0x02031800 + 0x220.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b528 writes 4 header words to (slot3_base + 0x220-0x22F) when slot index is 2; FUN_0801b940 reads them back; file offsets 0x1A20-0x1A2F.
fields.name: slot3_record_header

fields.description: Active-slot marker word at end of the persisted buffer, written by the slot copy/select routine.
fields.evidence: FUN_08025700 writes the selected-slot code word to SRAM 0x0E0032000 (mirrors to file offset 0x2000) via thunk_FUN_0863d630; baseline holds the default pattern 0x99999999.
fields.name: active_slot_marker
